summary: Regression check after two code-quality fixes (pytest reads ADMIN_PASSWORD from env; AuthContext.logout now console.error logs instead of swallow). Backend pytest: 32/32 passed with ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env set. Frontend E2E regression: register customer -> token stored in localStorage + httpOnly cookie, account-menu-trigger renders. Hard reload persists session (/api/auth/me -> 200, token intact). /account and /fitting-room load while logged in. Logout clears tg_token, /api/auth/me -> 401, open-auth-btn re-appears. Protected routes /fitting-room and /account redirect to / after logout. Admin login -> nav-admin link appears, /admin loads admin-page. Non-admin customer: nav-admin hidden; /admin redirects to /. PayPal /api/paypal/config returns configured:false, client_id:'' (no keys set, expected). Catalog loads 8 products; filter chips show 'Recycled Bio-Polymer' + 'Ember Amber' + 'Hemp Canvas' + 'Bamboo Micro-Knit' + 'Organic Bio-Fleece' + 'Cold Cyan' + 'Void Black' + 'Bio Olive'. No 'thermochromic' in visible DOM text (one legacy occurrence remains in index.css comment '/* Thermochromic helpers */' and the .thermo-shift utility class name inside the JS bundle — non-user-visible). Product detail -> Add to Cart opens cart-drawer with cart-item; cart-checkout-btn navigates to /checkout. Backend coverage for order creation + tracking_hash + stock decrement already proven green by pytest (TestOrders + TestSearchAndInventory). No behavioural regression from the fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css line 69 still has `/* Thermochromic helpers */` comment and a `.thermo-shift` utility class — low priority but a leftover from the removed thermochromic feature; consider renaming to `.accent-shift` for consistency with the new palette language.

AuthContext.logout(): fix now logs via console.error — good. Consider also surfacing a non-blocking toast when logout API fails (currently user state is still cleared client-side so UX is unaffected, but silent server-side logout failures could leave stale server sessions until TTL).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (register, reload-persistence, logout+redirect, admin+non-admin gating, catalog, cart, paypal-config)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct Header testids: open-auth-btn (when logged out), account-menu-trigger (dropdown trigger when logged in), menu-account, menu-admin, menu-logout, nav-admin (visible only for admin role). AuthModal uses auth-toggle-mode to switch between login/register (not separate tabs); auth-name-input only exists in register mode. CartDrawer: cart-drawer, cart-checkout-btn, cart-item-<pid>. Checkout: step-shipping -> checkout-to-delivery -> step-delivery -> checkout-to-payment -> step-payment with paymethod-demo/paymethod-paypal, paypal-not-configured notice (since no PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID), place-order-btn. CAUTION: do NOT fill all input elements blindly on /checkout — the header has a search input that will navigate away if filled; target checkout fields via the CField's data-testid pattern (`field-...`) or use locator('[data-testid="step-shipping"] input'). ADMIN_PASSWORD env is REQUIRED for pytest: `ADMIN_PASSWORD='TelluricAdmin#2026' pytest ...`.
rca of the issue: No defects. Code-review follow-up fixes (env-driven admin password in pytest; non-silent logout error logging) did not introduce any regression. All prior iteration-3 assertions still hold.
